bullets: [COOL THE HEAT, NOT YOUR BILLS] Summer electric bills shouldn't make you sweat twice. This 14,000 BTU portable AC runs a dual motor compressor with 400 CFM airflow, cooling rooms up to 750 square feet — your bedroom, living room, kitchen, dorm, or home gym. At just 2 kWh per day with a 7.8 CEER rating, it delivers serious cooling power without the post-summer bill shock.

[WHISPER AT 41 DB — YOU WON'T HEAR IT] Most portable air conditioners sound like a constant conversation in your room. This one doesn't. At 41 decibels in Silent Mode, it's quieter than a library whisper (45 dB). Sleep Mode dims every light — including a display you can turn completely off — drops the fan, and holds your set temperature all night. Set the 24-hour timer and wake up because you're rested, not because your AC woke you.

[SMART COOLING, FROM ANYWHERE] Start cooling before you walk through the door. Connect to the TEMPRIUM App and your portable AC is ready from your phone — whether you're on the couch or heading home from work. Alexa and Google Assistant give you hands-free voice control. Prefer buttons? Grab the remote or tap the LED touch panel. Four ways to control, zero reasons to get up.

[4-IN-1 COMFORT FOR EVERY SEASON] Cool on summer afternoons. Dry on humid nights. Fan on breezy days. Dehumidify when sticky air moves in. Then fine-tune with Turbo when you need fast relief, Silent for bedtime, Auto for set-it-and-forget-it, and Auto-Swing to spread airflow evenly across the whole room. This isn't just a portable AC — it's your year-round comfort system.

[SELF-EVAPORATING SYSTEM — NO DAILY DRAINING] Enjoy cooler air with less maintenance. The built-in self-evaporating system helps recycle collected moisture during operation, reducing the need for frequent manual draining in most cooling conditions. No daily bucket emptying, no messy routine — just steady comfort with washable filters that pop out easily for a quick rinse.

[SET UP IN 10 MINUTES. NO DRILL. NO DRAMA.] Renting an apartment? No outside window? No problem. The no-drill window kit fits frames from 20.5 to 50 inches — no tools, no holes, no landlord complaints. Unbox, attach the hose, plug in, and you're cooling. 360° wheels and a built-in handle let you roll it from bedroom to living room to home office. Backed by a full 1-year warranty so you can buy with confidence.
